job_spec.structural_change: storage re-partitioned: the one ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256 (174.7 um wide: 7.6 um pin-edge channels in the 194.4 um slot) -> THREE ot_sram_1r1w_128x256 (94.8 x 41.0 um, one column, >= 20 um channels on all sides, bank 0 / bank 1 / overflow+HEAD) at the ORIGINAL slot outline; RTL: f_q / f_fault / grp get pin registers (every face pin is a flop), the far-ROM latency constant FLP 11 becomes the static strap f_lat[4:0] (tag-line tap select, 0..31 edges); physical: faces swapped (far ROM S, SU N), all pins + clock on M5 N/S, routing and PG capped at M5 (legacy M8), pin flops firm at the pins, macro halo 2.16 -> 5.4 um, macro pin-edge M5 guard E+W, hold margin 30 ps; r2 (gate 17da18560: rs_q 2 x 512 loads, rst_n 316 loads, TT clock 280.6-384.3 ps): the macro-select register is one copy per lane (8 x 2 b, 64 loads each, gated with the lane's own decode), the rst_n port drives only a 2-sync + 3 kept-copy reset relay (answer side / prefetcher / tag line; release 3 edges after the port), kit recipe 2 (pin hold stages + pin flops)
